=== pam --help
Usage: pam [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...

  pam - Photo Archive Manager. Safe, local, reversible photo renaming.

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  apply   Rename the approved files in a plan.
  doctor  Check that pam's environment is ready.
  enrich  Add AI understanding to what pam has scanned.
  faces   Work with the local face model pack and the people pam has found.
  forget  Stop offering a photo folder.
  models  Manage the local Ollama models pam uses to caption photos.
  plan    Propose new names for everything pam has scanned.
  report  Look up what pam recorded: skipped files, duplicates, or one...
  review  Open a plan in your browser to review names.
  scan    Read a photo folder and its metadata into the catalog.
  start   Open pam in your browser: choose a folder, read it, review, rename.
  status  Show what pam knows about your photo folders, and what to do next.
  undo    Put an applied session's files back under their original names.
  update  Install a newer pam from GitHub, after you confirm.
  verify  Check pam's records for an archive.
=== pam apply --help
Usage: pam apply [OPTIONS] PLAN_ID

  Rename the approved files in a plan. The only command that changes anything.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder to apply to (needed only if pam knows
                  several).
  --all           Accept every name you have not decided, except low-confidence
                  ones, then apply.
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam doctor --help
Usage: pam doctor [OPTIONS]

  Check that pam's environment is ready.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
=== pam enrich --help
Usage: pam enrich [OPTIONS] [NAME]

  Add AI understanding to what pam has scanned. Renames nothing.

Options:
  --archive PATH                The photo folder to enrich (needed only if pam
                                knows several).
  --refresh-older-than-model V  Replace results made by a model older than this
                                version, then re-run.
  --help                        Show this message and exit.
=== pam faces --help
Usage: pam faces [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Work with the local face model pack and the people pam has found.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  calibrate  Show which cluster_epsilon keeps the people you named apart.
  cluster    Group the faces pam has found into one group per person.
  export     Write pam's faces and names to a file you keep.
  label      Name the people pam found, in your browser.
  manifest   Write pack.toml for a folder holding the face model files.
  purge      Delete every face and name pam holds.
=== pam faces calibrate --help
Usage: pam faces calibrate [OPTIONS]

  Show which cluster_epsilon keeps the people you named apart. Changes nothing.

Options:
  --archive PATH        The photo folder to report on (needed only if pam knows
                        several).
  --floor FLOAT         Leave out faces below this.
  --exclude-label NAME  Leave out a person.
  --exclude-path PATH   Leave out files (glob).
  --help                Show this message and exit.
=== pam faces cluster --help
Usage: pam faces cluster [OPTIONS]

  Group the faces pam has found into one group per person. Renames nothing.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder to cluster faces in (spec 3 refuses to
                  guess).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam faces export --help
Usage: pam faces export [OPTIONS]

  Write pam's faces and names to a file you keep. Touches no photograph.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder whose faces to export (spec 3 refuses to
                  guess).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam faces label --help
Usage: pam faces label [OPTIONS]

  Name the people pam found, in your browser. Renames nothing.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder whose people to name (spec 3 refuses to
                  guess).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam faces manifest --help
Usage: pam faces manifest [OPTIONS] DIRECTORY

  Write pack.toml for a folder holding the face model files.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
=== pam faces purge --help
Usage: pam faces purge [OPTIONS]

  Delete every face and name pam holds. Deletes no photograph.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder whose faces to delete (spec 3 refuses to
                  guess).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam forget --help
Usage: pam forget [OPTIONS] PATH

  Stop offering a photo folder. Keeps its catalog, history and files.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
=== pam models --help
Usage: pam models [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage the local Ollama models pam uses to caption photos.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  pull  Ask the local Ollama server to download a captioning model.
=== pam models pull --help
Usage: pam models pull [OPTIONS] [MODEL]

  Ask the local Ollama server to download a captioning model.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
=== pam plan --help
Usage: pam plan [OPTIONS]

  Propose new names for everything pam has scanned. Renames nothing.

Options:
  --archive PATH   The photo folder to plan for (needed only if pam knows
                   several).
  --template TEXT  Use this naming template instead of the configured one.
  --help           Show this message and exit.
=== pam report --help
Usage: pam report [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...

  Look up what pam recorded: skipped files, duplicates, or one rename run.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  duplicates  List identical files, and photos that look alike.
  session     Show what one rename run did, and whether it still holds.
  skipped     List every file pam did not read, and why.
=== pam report duplicates --help
Usage: pam report duplicates [OPTIONS]

  List identical files, and photos that look alike.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder to report on (needed only if pam knows
                  several).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam report session --help
Usage: pam report session [OPTIONS] SESSION_ID

  Show what one rename run did, and whether it still holds.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder to report on (needed only if pam knows
                  several).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam report skipped --help
Usage: pam report skipped [OPTIONS]

  List every file pam did not read, and why.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder to report on (needed only if pam knows
                  several).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam review --help
Usage: pam review [OPTIONS] [PLAN_ID]

  Open a plan in your browser to review names. Renames only what you confirm
  there.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder to review (needed only if pam knows several).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam scan --help
Usage: pam scan [OPTIONS] PATH

  Read a photo folder and its metadata into the catalog. Renames nothing.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
=== pam start --help
Usage: pam start [OPTIONS] [PATH]

  Open pam in your browser: choose a folder, read it, review, rename.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
=== pam status --help
Usage: pam status [OPTIONS]

  Show what pam knows about your photo folders, and what to do next.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder to summarize (without it, every folder pam
                  knows).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam undo --help
Usage: pam undo [OPTIONS] SESSION_ID

  Put an applied session's files back under their original names.

Options:
  --archive PATH  The photo folder to undo in (needed only if pam knows
                  several).
  --help          Show this message and exit.
=== pam update --help
Usage: pam update [OPTIONS]

  Install a newer pam from GitHub, after you confirm. The only command that goes
  online.

Options:
  --check                Only say whether a newer pam is offered. Downloads
                         nothing.
  --channel [stable|rc]  Which releases to follow: stable ones, or release
                         candidates too.  [default: stable]
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
=== pam verify --help
Usage: pam verify [OPTIONS]

  Check pam's records for an archive. Reads only; renames nothing.

Options:
  --archive PATH        The photo folder to check (needed only if pam knows
                        several).
  --deep                Also re-read a random sample of your files from disk (1%
                        unless --sample) and compare the bytes.
  --seed INTEGER        Draw --deep's sample reproducibly, so a finding can be
                        re-checked.
  --sample FLOAT RANGE  With --deep: the percentage of files to re-read (default
                        1; 100 re-reads them all).  [0<x<=100]
  --help                Show this message and exit.
